{{Quote|A double solar eclipse occurred on the fourth planet in the Debray System.|[[M-TD]], to [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]]|<ref name="YJK:DA" />}}
The '''Debray system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained at least four [[Planet/Legends|planets]].<ref name="YJK:DA" />

The Debray system was situated on the general route between the planets of [[Kuar]],<ref name="YJK:DA" /> in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]],<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[Shumavar/Legends|Shumavar]],<ref name="YJK:DA" /> in the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

In [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> a double [[Star/Legends|solar]] [[Eclipse/Legends|eclipse]] occurred on the fourth planet of the system.<ref name="YJK:DA" />
